scope: deterministic synthetic UnifiedBody; conditional one-cycle forecasts
contract: Both arms use identical observed states, requested actions and 0.1-second duration. Validation and test outcomes are never passed to learn. MAE is the mean over energy, fatigue, sleep_pressure, pain and balance; decision correctness is matching the fixed self-maintenance contract. Improvement requires strictly smaller held-out MAE, unchanged budgets and preserved parameters across a fresh process. No parameter tuning against this fixture is allowed.
